t: Should I get a Cpu Contact frame - PCPartPicker
s: You don't really need it as the AMD's CPUs are square, so there is no bending of the CPU that requires a contact frame to fix. It's only an Intel CPU problem, as their CPUs are rectangular. You can buy this to increase pressure on the CPU to hold it down better, which may improve thermals, and to prevent thermal paste to get in between the outer gaps of the AM5 CPUs (cosmetic reason, does not harm performance in any way).
